intervals.note: Bounds are those of the LUX detector (cooled and filled in February 2013; data taking ended 2 May 2016); the collaboration's own founding date is not published in the sources read.
intervals.quote: a dual-phase xenon time-projection chamber operating at the Sanford Underground Research Facility (Lead, South Dakota), was cooled and filled in February 2013

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: LUX data taking ended 2 May 2016; the personnel moved to the LZ collaboration (collaboration:lz).

name: LUX Collaboration
notes: No roster or member count was found in the sources read; the Atlas records no memberships for this collaboration.

summary.plain: The international team that built and ran the Large Underground Xenon (LUX) dark matter detector a mile underground in South Dakota, and whose experience led to LZ.
summary.technical: LUX Collaboration: authors of the LUX detector paper and of the WS2013 and WS2014-16 WIMP-search results (dual-phase xenon TPC at SURF). No formation date, roster or member count is published in the sources read; the interval below is the LUX detector's life (filled February 2013, last data 2 May 2016).
